hints: XOR has the cancellation rule x XOR x=0.
Build prefix XORs; a range XOR is the XOR of the prefix ending at b and the prefix before a.
No ordering or numeric magnitude assumptions are needed.
analogy: XORing the same prefix twice cancels all values before the requested range.
example: For [5,2,7], XOR of positions 2..3 is 2 XOR 7=5.
algorithm: Build px[0]=0 and px[i]=px[i-1] XOR a[i]. Answer query [a,b] with px[b] XOR px[a-1].
correctness: Each value before a appears in both prefixes and cancels; each value in the range appears once and remains.
